author: agent
question: Can AI add pixel-art effects to my images?

points.claim: It has two hundred forty-four pixel effects, each one a small piece of code.
points.spoken: There are two hundred forty-four pixel effects, and every one is a small piece of code.
points.source_note: README: 244 pixel art effects, every one a small piece of code
points.title: 244 effects
points.sub: Each effect is code you can read.

points.claim: You can recolour and mirror an effect, then export a sprite sheet.
points.spoken: You can recolour and mirror an effect, then export a sprite sheet for your engine.
points.source_note: README: recolor and mirror, export sprite sheets
points.title: Recolour and export

points.claim: Characters act out effects: a wind-up, a release, then a recovery.
points.spoken: Effects with a character are acted out, with a wind-up, a release, then a recovery.
points.source_note: README 'acting': wind up, let go, freeze on contact, recover
points.title: Effects that act
points.sub: A hit lands and the target reacts.

points.claim: A Claude Code skill makes new effects by drafting, rendering, looking and refining.
points.spoken: A Claude Code skill makes new effects the way a pixel artist would: draft, render, look, refine.
points.source_note: README: skill that drafts, renders, looks and refines
points.title: Make your own
points.sub: The skill loops until it looks right.

catch: These are effects for games and engines, not edits to your existing photos.
